> Stack: part 3 of 3, based on #44552, itself on #44551. Until those merge this diff also shows their commits; review only the last commit.
>
> Kimi-K3 on gfx950 series (all drafts): #44547 gfx950 verify argmax + tuned rows, #44548 KDA, #44549 MLA decode, #44550 MLA prefill, #44551 → #44552 → #44553 collectives, MoE decode, MoE prefill. The end-to-end numbers in each PR are for all seven together.

## Motivation

Kimi-K3 prefill on gfx950 leaves three MoE-side costs: the A8W4 experts quantize activations to MXFP8 even where
aiter's MXFP4 x MXFP4 kernels are faster, the merged MoE front GEMM is followed by a separate SiTU kernel for the
shared experts, and every rank runs the latent tail (norm, up-projection, adds) and the FFN-side AttnRes read on all
rows of 4K-8K-token chunks after the all-reduce.

## Modifications

Gated on gfx950.

- SiTU MXFP4 MoE calls of at least `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_PREFILL_MOE_A4W4_MIN_TOKENS` (1025) tokens quantize activations to
  MXFP4 and run aiter's a4w4 kernels on the gate/up-interleaved a8w4 weights (`gate_mode=INTERLEAVE`), only for padded
  sizes whose aiter config resolves to the mxmoe stage 1, the one that honors that layout (`mxfp4.py` records the
  interleaving on the quant info).
- `kimi_k3_front_situ`: at the prefill sizes where it beats the tuned GEMM + SiTU (129-160, 193-320, 1152-1280
  tokens), the merged front runs as one Triton GEMM whose gated tiles pair gate row j with up row 768 + j and write
  SiTU(gate) * up (`SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FRONT_SITU`); configs are compiled at weight-merge time.
- Row-sharded tails for batches of at least `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_ROW_SHARDED_TAIL_MIN_TOKENS` (4096): the MoE reduce-
  scatters its [latent | shared] partials by rows, runs norm + up-projection + shared + residual add on this rank's
  1/8 of the rows and all-gathers the stream; with `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_ROW_SHARDED_ATTN_READ` the attention output's sum,
  the residual add and the FFN read also run on the shard (`AttnBankState.ffn_row_shards`), leaving the residual
  there for the tail. `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_ROW_SHARDED_ATTN_MIN_TOKENS` raises the attention side's threshold separately.

| New env var | Default |
|---|---|
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_PREFILL_MOE_A4W4_MIN_TOKENS` | 1025 |
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FRONT_SITU` | on |
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_ROW_SHARDED_TAIL_MIN_TOKENS` | 4096 |
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_ROW_SHARDED_ATTN_READ` | on |
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_ROW_SHARDED_ATTN_MIN_TOKENS` | 0 (with the tail) |

## Accuracy Tests

**Setup for every number below:** 8x MI350X (gfx950, 1000 W), Kimi-K3 (MXFP4 MoE, bf16 attention) at TP8 with EAGLE3
(topk 1, 3 steps, 4 draft tokens), FP8 KV cache, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, aiter's K3 FlyDSL kernels
(`AITER_SITUV2_A8W4=1 AITER_FLYDSL_FORCE=1 SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT=1`), CUDA graphs for bs 1/2/4/8/16, and an aiter bf16 GEMM table with K3 rows re-tuned on this pod with HBM-resident weights
(`AITER_CONFIG_GEMM_BF16`; not part of this PR, it belongs in aiter's model configs). EAGLE3 on K3 needs the
aux-capture commit of #43599, applied locally for these runs. Microbenchmarks rotate their weights through HBM.
Per-feature numbers were measured on the integration branch of this series as each piece landed (Oct 13-14,
earlier `main`); the end-to-end numbers are from the integration of all seven PRs rebased on `main` b67785153a,
together with #43599's aux capture, #41867 and #41848.

- GSM8K 400: a4w4 prefill 0.9825 / accept 3.619; row-sharded tails (both sides, >= 4096) 0.9875 / 3.621; with the
  40 / 56-token opt-in thresholds 0.9875. End-to-end integration: see below.
- `test_kimi_k3_moe_a4w4.py` (new): from the default threshold aiter's config resolves to the interleave-capable
  stage 1 and the a4w4 output tracks a8w4 (cosine > 0.95; a misread gate/up layout gives ~0.004).
- `test_kimi_k3_front_situ.py` (new): the fused front against an fp32 GEMM followed by SiTU on its bf16 output.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- a4w4 vs a8w4 per MoE call (K3 TP8): 0.84-0.89x at 1025-2048 tokens, 0.77x at 4096, 0.85x at 8192; uncached 50K
  prefill 3.70 -> 3.60 s.
- Front SiTU vs tuned GEMM + SiTU (median of alternating runs): 144 tokens -31%, 160 -16%, 208-320 -6..-31%,
  1152-1280 -2..-7.5%; in-server extend TTFT -0.4..-2%.
- Row-sharded tails (8K rows): bank read 477 -> 56 us and up-projection 387 -> 55 us on 1K rows, RCCL RS + AG 652 vs
  INT8 quick all-reduce 498 us; uncached 50K prefill 3.47 -> 3.40 s with both sides, agentic turn TTFT neutral.
  Below ~4K tokens RCCL's fixed cost outweighs it (1.9K-token turn +2.5%), hence the default.

### End to end (all seven PRs)

Integration of the seven PRs on `main` b67785153a, with #43599's aux capture, #41867 and #41848; agentic replay of
lightseekorg/agentic-dataset SWE-smith conversations (multi-turn, ~50K-token cached prefixes, 500 output tokens,
greedy), EAGLE3 as above. TokenSpeed (7e2f1deb, same pod, same workload) for reference.

| Concurrency | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SGLang, tok/s/user | 217.2 | 156.6 | 114.1 | 73.4 | 43.4 |
| TokenSpeed, tok/s/user | 188.1 | 129.5 | 86.1 | 59.7 | 35.5 |

786/786 requests OK. GSM8K 400: 0.9825 / accept length 3.619. Decode cycle C1 / C4 / C16: 15.8 / 23.2 / 38.9 ms;
agentic turn TTFT (50K cached + 1.9K new tokens) 230-248 ms; uncached 50K-token prefill 3.27 s.

and only the stream is all-gathered.

+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+
 # _agg_kernel keeps a next_pow2(nvb) x next_pow2(H) fp32 tile in registers, and
 # that is the whole basis of its speed. Past this budget it spills and loses to
 # the 2-kernel Triton pipeline it replaces: measured at T=4 on MI355X,
 # next_pow2(nvb)=8 is 2.0x faster, 16 is 1.2x, 32 is 0.2x. K3 sits right at the
 # limit with H=7168 (one masked tile of 8192) and nvb <= 8.

+# On gfx950, batches of at least STREAM_MIN_ROWS whose bank tile pads to 8 rows read
+# the bank two rows at a time instead (_agg_stream_kernel): many CTAs per CU then beat
+# one register-bound CTA. Measured on MI350X; at 4 rows the register tile still wins.
+STREAM_MIN_ROWS: int = 64
+STREAM_MIN_TILE_ROWS: int = 8
 
 
 @cache
@@ -133,6 +140,84 @@ def _agg_kernel(
     tl.store(out_ptr + t * stride_o + offs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
 
 
+@triton.jit
+def _agg_stream_kernel(
+    prefix_ptr,  # [T, H]
+    addend_ptr,  # [T, H]; the pending residual, or prefix_ptr when not HAS_ADD
+    prefix_out_ptr,  # [T, H]; materialized prefix, written when HAS_ADD
+    bank_ptr,  # [T, NB, H]
+    cw_ptr,  # [H] fp32; score_norm weight * score_proj weight
+    ow_ptr,  # [H]; out RMSNorm weight, unread when not APPLY_OUT_NORM
+    out_ptr,  # [T, H]
+    score_eps,
+    out_eps,
+    nvb,
+    stride_pm,
+    stride_am,
+    stride_om,
+    stride_bm,
+    stride_bb,
+    stride_o,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_ADD: tl.constexpr,
+    WRITE_BANK: tl.constexpr,
+    APPLY_OUT_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """_agg_kernel for prefill-sized batches: the bank is read ROWS rows at a time
+    (a runtime loop with an online softmax), so a CTA holds a bounded tile instead
+    of the whole bank and enough CTAs share a CU to stream at HBM bandwidth. Same
+    math as _agg_kernel; the running rescale rounds differently in the last ulp."""
+    t = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    mask = offs < H
+
+    row = tl.load(prefix_ptr + t * stride_pm + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    if HAS_ADD:
+        row = (
+            row.to(tl.float32)
+            + tl.load(addend_ptr + t * stride_am + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(
+                tl.float32
+            )
+        ).to(prefix_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+        tl.store(prefix_out_ptr + t * stride_om + offs, row, mask=mask)
+    if WRITE_BANK:
+        tl.store(bank_ptr + t * stride_bm + nvb * stride_bb + offs, row, mask=mask)
+    acc = row.to(tl.float32)
+
+    cw = tl.load(cw_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    m = tl.sum(acc * cw) / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(acc * acc) / H + score_eps)
+    denom = 1.0
+    offs_r = tl.arange(0, ROWS)
+    for i in range(0, nvb, ROWS):
+        mask_r = (i + offs_r) < nvb
+        tile = tl.load(
+            bank_ptr
+            + t * stride_bm
+            + (i + offs_r)[:, None] * stride_bb
+            + offs[None, :],
+            mask=mask_r[:, None] & mask[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        score = tl.sum(tile * cw[None, :], axis=1) / tl.sqrt(
+            tl.sum(tile * tile, axis=1) / H + score_eps
+        )
+        m_new = tl.maximum(m, tl.max(tl.where(mask_r, score, -float("inf"))))
+        alpha = tl.exp(m - m_new)
+        w = tl.where(mask_r, tl.exp(score - m_new), 0.0)
+        denom = denom * alpha + tl.sum(w)
+        acc = acc * alpha + tl.sum(w[:, None] * tile, axis=0)
+        m = m_new
+    acc = acc / denom
+
+    if APPLY_OUT_NORM:
+        scale = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(acc * acc) / H + out_eps)
+        ow = tl.load(ow_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        acc = acc * scale * ow
+    tl.store(out_ptr + t * stride_o + offs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)

+csrc/kimi_k3/attn_res/read_hip.cuh), over communication/k3_ll_comm_hip's
+scratch: the all-gather of the next stream, whose every rank finishes one
+[T, H / 8] column slice in-kernel from the column-parallel latent-MoE tail's
+split-K partials; and the attention output's all-reduce with the residual
+add, ahead of the FFN-side read.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+import torch

+"""The communicator of Kimi-K3's TP8 LL collectives on gfx950 (csrc/kimi_k3/comm/ll_hip.cuh):
+the attention-residual read's stream gather and the attention output's all-reduce
+read (attention/k3_attn_res_read_hip), and the column-parallel MoE front's gather
+(moe/k3_front_gather_hip).
+
+Their scratch is the meta buffer tail of a dedicated aiter CustomAllreduce,
+which is never used for anything else: one region and one row of flags per
+collective.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from aiter.dist.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce import CustomAllreduce
+
+WORLD_SIZE: int = 8
+MAX_ROWS: int = 64
+# Per region: 2 epochs x world x rows x lines-per-row x 16 B (8 payload bytes a
+# line). The kernels hardcode the region order and line counts.
+_LINES_PER_ROW = (
+    2 * 7168 // WORLD_SIZE // 8,  # attention-residual read: an H / 8 bf16 slice
+    2 * 72,  # MoE front: [latent | logits] slices, padded to 72 vectors
+)
+# Then the all-reduce read's region: whole rows, two 16-byte lines per 8 bf16.
+AR_MAX_ROWS: int = 16
+_AR_LINES_PER_ROW = 2 * 7168 // 8
+# Then the two-shot all-reduce read's: the owner's rows from each rank, then each row's sum.
+AR2_MAX_ROWS: int = 64
+_SCRATCH_BYTES: int = (
+    sum(2 * WORLD_SIZE * MAX_ROWS * n * 16 for n in _LINES_PER_ROW)
+    + 2 * WORLD_SIZE * AR_MAX_ROWS * _AR_LINES_PER_ROW * 16
+    + 2 * WORLD_SIZE * (AR2_MAX_ROWS // WORLD_SIZE) * _AR_LINES_PER_ROW * 16
+    + 2 * AR2_MAX_ROWS * _AR_LINES_PER_ROW * 16
+)
+
+
+class LLComm(NamedTuple):
+    comm: CustomAllreduce
+    # rank-local flags: [MAX_ROWS] attention-residual gather rows, then [MAX_ROWS] front rows
+    epochs: torch.Tensor
+    # rank-local, [AR_MAX_ROWS] each: the all-reduce read's row flags, and per row the
+    # count of this rank's pushers that took its flag (kept at 0 between launches)
+    ar_epochs: torch.Tensor
+    ar_pushed: torch.Tensor
+    # rank-local, [AR2_MAX_ROWS] each: the two-shot all-reduce read's row flags, and per
+    # row the count of this rank's workgroups done with its flag (kept at 0 between launches)
+    ar2_epochs: torch.Tensor
+    ar2_done: torch.Tensor
+    # The attention-residual reads' bank partials, computed ahead of them (rank-local
+    # fp32): [2, MAX_ROWS, H] weighted sums and [2, MAX_ROWS, 2] (max, sum), one slot per
+    # read kind (attention side, FFN side).
+    bank_acc: torch.Tensor
+    bank_ms: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def create_ll_comm(cpu_group, device: torch.device) -> Optional[LLComm]:
+    """Collective over ``cpu_group`` (a non-NCCL group): every rank calls it,
+    outside graph capture."""
+    from aiter.dist.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce import CustomAllreduce
+
+    # aiter sizes the meta buffer as Signal + 2 * max_size.
+    comm = CustomAllreduce(cpu_group, device, max_size=(_SCRATCH_BYTES + 1) // 2)
+    if comm.disabled or comm.world_size != WORLD_SIZE:
+        return None
+    epochs = torch.zeros(2 * MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar_epochs = torch.zeros(AR_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar_pushed = torch.zeros(AR_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar2_epochs = torch.zeros(AR2_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar2_done = torch.zeros(AR2_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    bank_acc = torch.zeros(2, MAX_ROWS, 7168, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    bank_ms = torch.zeros(2, MAX_ROWS, 2, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    return LLComm(
+        comm, epochs, ar_epochs, ar_pushed, ar2_epochs, ar2_done, bank_acc, bank_ms
+    )

+"""Kimi-K3 latent-MoE input step in one Triton GEMM with the shared experts' SiTU in its epilogue.
+
+One launch over the merged front weight [shared gate | shared up | router | latent down] (rows).
+A gated tile pairs gate row j with up row N_HALF + j in adjacent columns, so it streams the same
+weight bytes as any other tile and writes SiTU(gate) * up; the rest write router logits and the
+latent input. Replaces the merged-front GEMM followed by a separate SiTU kernel for the prefill
+batch sizes covered() admits.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# (first, last tokens, (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, BLOCK_K, GROUP_M, num_warps, num_stages, waves_per_eu)):
+# the sizes where it beats the tuned merged-front GEMM + SiTU kernel on MI350X, each with the
+# fastest config of a sweep; at the GEMM's tuned sizes and between these, the GEMM wins.
+_RANGES = (
+    (129, 160, (32, 128, 128, 8, 4, 3, 4)),
+    (193, 256, (128, 64, 128, 8, 4, 3, 1)),
+    (257, 320, (64, 128, 128, 8, 4, 3, 2)),
+    (1152, 1280, (256, 128, 64, 8, 8, 3, 1)),
+)
+
+
+def covered(num_tokens: int) -> bool:
+    return any(first <= num_tokens <= last for first, last, _ in _RANGES)
+
+
+def _config(num_tokens: int):
+    for first, last, config in _RANGES:
+        if first <= num_tokens <= last:
+            return config
+    raise ValueError(f"no front SiTU config for {num_tokens} tokens")
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _tanh(x):
+    return 2.0 / (1.0 + tl.exp(-2.0 * x)) - 1.0
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _remap_xcd(pid, num_pids, NUM_XCDS: tl.constexpr):
+    # Hardware deals pids round-robin over the XCDs; give each XCD (one L2) a run of
+    # consecutive pids, so the programs that share a weight panel share its L2.
+    pids_per_xcd = (num_pids + NUM_XCDS - 1) // NUM_XCDS
+    tall_xcds = num_pids % NUM_XCDS
+    tall_xcds = tl.where(tall_xcds == 0, NUM_XCDS, tall_xcds)
+    xcd = pid % NUM_XCDS
+    local_pid = pid // NUM_XCDS
+    return tl.where(
+        xcd < tall_xcds,
+        xcd * pids_per_xcd + local_pid,
+        tall_xcds * pids_per_xcd + (xcd - tall_xcds) * (pids_per_xcd - 1) + local_pid,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _grouped_pid(pid, num_pid_m, num_pid_n, GROUP_M: tl.constexpr):
+    if GROUP_M == 1:
+        pid_m = pid // num_pid_n
+        pid_n = pid % num_pid_n
+    else:
+        num_pid_in_group = GROUP_M * num_pid_n
+        first_pid_m = pid // num_pid_in_group * GROUP_M
+        group_size_m = tl.minimum(num_pid_m - first_pid_m, GROUP_M)
+        pid_m = first_pid_m + pid % group_size_m
+        pid_n = pid % num_pid_in_group // group_size_m
+    return pid_m, pid_n
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _front_situ_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    act_ptr,
+    rest_ptr,
+    M,
+    stride_xm,
+    stride_am,
+    stride_rm,
+    beta,
+    linear_beta,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    N_HALF: tl.constexpr,
+    N_REST: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP_M: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    num_pid_m = tl.cdiv(M, BLOCK_M)
+    n_gated: tl.constexpr = 2 * N_HALF // BLOCK_N
+    num_pid_n: tl.constexpr = n_gated + N_REST // BLOCK_N
+    # gfx950 parts carry 8 XCDs
+    pid = _remap_xcd(tl.program_id(0), num_pid_m * num_pid_n, NUM_XCDS=8)
+    pid_m, pid_n = _grouped_pid(pid, num_pid_m, num_pid_n, GROUP_M)
+    gated = pid_n < n_gated
+    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    # Gated tile: column 2j is gate row j, column 2j + 1 the matching up row.
+    rows = tl.where(
+        gated,
+        pid_n * (BLOCK_N // 2) + cols // 2 + (cols % 2) * N_HALF,
+        2 * N_HALF + (pid_n - n_gated) * BLOCK_N + cols,
+    )
+    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    offs_k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    x_ptrs = x_ptr + (offs_m % M)[:, None] * stride_xm + offs_k[None, :]
+    w_ptrs = w_ptr + rows[None, :].to(tl.int64) * K + offs_k[:, None]
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for _ in range(0, K, BLOCK_K):
+        a = tl.load(x_ptrs)
+        b = tl.load(w_ptrs, cache_modifier=".cg")
+        acc = tl.dot(a, b, acc)
+        x_ptrs += BLOCK_K
+        w_ptrs += BLOCK_K
+    mask_m = offs_m[:, None] < M
+    if gated:
+        # The gate and up projections are bf16 before SiTU reads them, as in the unfused pair.
+        acc = acc.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+        gate, up = tl.split(tl.reshape(acc, [BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N // 2, 2]))
+        gate = beta * _tanh(gate / beta) * tl.sigmoid(gate)
+        up = linear_beta * _tanh(up / linear_beta)
+        offs_a = pid_n * (BLOCK_N // 2) + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N // 2)
+        tl.store(
+            act_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_am + offs_a[None, :],
+            (gate * up).to(act_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+            mask=mask_m,
+        )
+    else:
+        offs_r = (pid_n - n_gated) * BLOCK_N + cols
+        tl.store(
+            rest_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * stride_rm + offs_r[None, :],
+            acc.to(rest_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+            mask=mask_m,
+        )
+
+
+def front_situ(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    gate_up_rows: int,
+    beta: float,
+    linear_beta: float,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """(SiTU(x @ gate.T) * (x @ up.T), x @ rest.T) for weight = [gate; up; rest] rows, gate and
+    up gate_up_rows / 2 rows each; x [M, K] bf16 (row stride free), weight contiguous."""
+    m, k = x.shape
+    block_m, block_n, block_k, group_m, num_warps, num_stages, waves_per_eu = _config(m)
+    n_half = gate_up_rows // 2
+    n_rest = weight.shape[0] - gate_up_rows
+    assert gate_up_rows % block_n == 0 and n_rest % block_n == 0 and k % block_k == 0
+    assert x.stride(-1) == 1 and weight.is_contiguous()
+    act = torch.empty((m, n_half), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    rest = torch.empty((m, n_rest), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    grid = (triton.cdiv(m, block_m) * ((gate_up_rows + n_rest) // block_n),)
+    _front_situ_kernel[grid](
+        x,
+        weight,
+        act,
+        rest,
+        m,
+        x.stride(0),
+        act.stride(0),
+        rest.stride(0),
+        beta,
+        linear_beta,
+        K=k,
+        N_HALF=n_half,
+        N_REST=n_rest,
+        BLOCK_M=block_m,
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=block_k,
+        GROUP_M=group_m,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+        num_stages=num_stages,
+        waves_per_eu=waves_per_eu,
+        matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    )
+    return act, rest
+
+
+def warmup(
+    weight: torch.Tensor, gate_up_rows: int, beta: float, linear_beta: float
+) -> None:
+    """Compile every config before serving: prefill sizes are not graph-captured."""
+    for first, _, _ in _RANGES:
+        x = weight.new_zeros((first, weight.shape[1]))
+        front_situ(x, weight, gate_up_rows, beta, linear_beta)

+"""Fused Kimi-K3 latent-MoE tail for small decode batches on gfx950.
+
+One launch for what the TP8 latent MoE otherwise runs as three (RMSNorm, the
+3584 -> 7168 up-projection, and the add3 with the shared-expert output and the
+residual prefix):
+    proj = bf16(inv_rms(latent) * (bf16(latent * norm_weight) @ up_weight.T))
+    out  = bf16(proj + shared [+ prefix])                         # fp32 add
+The per-row 1/rms commutes with the GEMM, so it is accumulated in the same pass
+over the latent and applied in the epilogue; the GEMM input is rounded to bf16
+before the row scale instead of after it, within bf16 noise of the unfused chain.
+
+Decode M is tiny, so this is a skinny GEMM bound by streaming up_weight once:
+each program owns BLOCK_N output columns for all M rows and walks K in full,
+with the weight tile as the MFMA A operand in its natural [N, K] layout.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl

+# Largest decode batch this path is tuned for; larger M keeps the unfused chain,
+# which is faster from M=48 on MI350X with HBM-streamed weights.

+def _latent_tail_kernel(
+    latent_ptr,  # [M, L] bf16
+    norm_w_ptr,  # [L]
+    w_ptr,  # [H, L] bf16
+    shared_ptr,  # [M, H] bf16
+    prefix_ptr,  # [M, H] bf16
+    out_ptr,  # [M, H] bf16
+    M,
+    eps,
+    stride_lm,
+    stride_wn,
+    stride_sm,
+    stride_pm,
+    stride_om,
+    L: tl.constexpr,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_PREFIX: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid_n = tl.program_id(0)
+    offs_m = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    mask_m = offs_m < M
+    mask_n = offs_n < H
+
+    # acc[n, m] = sum_k W[n, k] * bf16(x[m, k] * nw[k]); sq[m] = sum_k x[m, k]^2
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_N, BLOCK_M], dtype=tl.float32)
+    sq = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for k0 in tl.range(0, L, BLOCK_K):

+    w_ptr,  # [N, L] bf16
+    part_ptr,  # [SPLITS, M, N] fp32
+    sq_ptr,  # [SPLITS, M] fp32
+    M,
+    stride_lm,
+    stride_wn,

+    pid_k = tl.program_id(1)

+    mask_m = offs_m < M
+    xt = tl.load(
+        latent_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_lm + offs_k[:, None],
+        mask=mask_m[None, :],
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    nw = tl.load(norm_w_ptr + offs_k).to(tl.float32)
+    w = tl.load(
+        w_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * stride_wn + offs_k[None, :],
+        mask=(offs_n < N)[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+        cache_modifier=".cg",
+    )
+    acc = tl.dot(w, (xt * nw[:, None]).to(tl.bfloat16))
+    tl.store(
+        part_ptr + (pid_k * M + offs_m[None, :]) * N + offs_n[:, None],
+        acc,
+        mask=mask_m[None, :] & (offs_n < N)[:, None],
+    )
+    if pid_n == 0:
+        tl.store(sq_ptr + pid_k * M + offs_m, tl.sum(xt * xt, axis=0), mask=mask_m)

+def k3_latent_tail_partials(
+    latent: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    up_weight: torch.Tensor,

+    # measured on MI350X (N = 896, HBM weights) against 16
+    block_n: int = 32,

+    """The tail GEMM of up_weight's [N, L] rows, split over L: per chunk k,
+    part[k] = bf16(latent * norm_weight)[:, chunk] @ up_weight[:, chunk].T

+    N = up_weight.shape[0]

+    _latent_tail_partial_kernel[(triton.cdiv(N, block_n), PARTIAL_SPLITS)](

+        norm_weight,
+        up_weight,
+        part,
+        sq,
+        M,
+        latent.stride(0),
+        up_weight.stride(0),
+        N=N,
+        BLOCK_M=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(M)),
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=L // PARTIAL_SPLITS,
+        num_warps=4,
+        num_stages=1,
+        matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    )

+

+def supports_latent_tail(

+    prefix: Optional[torch.Tensor],

+    return (

+        and latent.stride(-1) == 1
+        and up_weight.is_contiguous()

+            prefix is None

+
+
+def k3_latent_tail(
+    latent: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,

+    shared: torch.Tensor,

+        latent.stride(0),
+        up_weight.stride(0),
+        shared.stride(0),

+        out.stride(0),

+        BLOCK_M=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(M)),
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=block_k,
+        HAS_PREFIX=prefix is not None,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+        num_stages=3,
+        waves_per_eu=waves_per_eu,
+        matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    )

+csrc/kimi_k3/comm/front_gather_hip.cuh): every rank's [T, 112] router logits
+and [T, 448] latent columns into the full [T, 896] logits and [T, 3584]
+latent, over communication/k3_ll_comm_hip's scratch.
+"""
+

+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.k3_ll_comm_hip import MAX_ROWS, WORLD_SIZE, LLComm

+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module

+LATENT_SIZE: int = 3584
+SLICE_SIZE: int = (NUM_EXPERTS + LATENT_SIZE) // WORLD_SIZE
+TOPK: int = 16
+SHARED_INTER: int = 768  # the shared expert's TP8 intermediate width
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _module() -> Module:
+    from aiter.jit.core import AITER_CSRC_DIR
+
+    return load_jit(
+        "kimi_k3_front_gather",
+        cuda_files=["kimi_k3/comm/front_gather_hip.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("run", "k3_front_gather::K3FrontGatherKernel::run")],
+        # AITER's CustomAllreduce, whose meta buffers hold the gather scratch
+        extra_include_paths=[f"{AITER_CSRC_DIR}/include"],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
+    )
+

+    """Whether front_gather can activate the shared expert's gate_up."""
+    return (
+        gate_up.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and gate_up.shape == (slices.shape[0], 2 * SHARED_INTER)
+        and gate_up.stride() == slices.stride()
+        and gate_up.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+    )
+
+
+def covered(slices: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return (
+        0 < slices.shape[0] <= MAX_ROWS
+        and slices.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and slices.shape[1] == SLICE_SIZE
+        and slices.stride(1) == 1
+        and slices.stride(0) % 8 == 0
+        and slices.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+    )
+
+
+class FrontGather(NamedTuple):
+    logits: torch.Tensor  # [T, 896] bf16
+    latent: torch.Tensor  # [T, 3584] bf16
+    # MXFP8 stage-1 activations of the latent (quant): [T, 3584] fp8 e4m3 and
+    # [T, 112] e8m0 token-major scales, for aiter's mxfp4_moe_sort_fwd
+    a1: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    a1_scale: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    # router top-k (bias given): [T, 16] fp32 weights and int32 ids
+    topk_weights: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    topk_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    # the shared expert's SiTU activation (gate_up given): [T, 768] bf16
+    situ: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+
+
+def front_gather(
+    slices: torch.Tensor,
+    comm: LLComm,
+    *,
+    quant: bool = False,
+    bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    routed_scaling_factor: float = 1.0,
+    renormalize: bool = True,
+    gate_up: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    situ_beta: float = 1.0,
+    situ_linear_beta: float = 1.0,

+    """Gather every rank's slices [T, 112 + 448] (rank r: experts
+    [112 r, 112 r + 112), latent columns [448 r, 448 r + 448)) into the full

+    fp32 [896]) add the MXFP8 latent and the top-16 routes (sigmoid scores,

+    device = slices.device
+    logits = slices.new_empty((rows, NUM_EXPERTS))
+    latent = slices.new_empty((rows, LATENT_SIZE))

+    a1 = (
+        torch.empty((rows, LATENT_SIZE), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+        if quant
+        else unread
+    )
+    a1_scale = (
+        torch.empty((rows, LATENT_SIZE // 32), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+        if quant
+        else unread
+    )
+    route = bias is not None
+    if route:
+        topk_ids = torch.empty((rows, TOPK), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        topk_weights = torch.empty((rows, TOPK), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    else:
+        bias = topk_ids = topk_weights = unread
+    situ = gate_up is not None
+    situ_out = slices.new_empty((rows, SHARED_INTER)) if situ else unread

+        comm.comm._ptr,
+        slices,
+        logits,
+        latent,
+        a1,
+        a1_scale,
+        comm.epochs,
+        quant,
+        bias,
+        topk_ids,
+        topk_weights,
+        route,
+        float(routed_scaling_factor),
+        renormalize,
+        gate_up if situ else unread,
+        situ_out,
+        situ,
+        float(situ_beta),
+        float(situ_linear_beta),

+        latent,
+        a1.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn) if quant else None,
+        a1_scale.view(torch.float8_e8m0fnu) if quant else None,
+        topk_weights if route else None,
+        topk_ids if route else None,
+        situ_out if situ else None,
+    )

+"""Fused Kimi-K3 router top-k + aiter moe_sorting for decode-sized batches (gfx950).
+
+One launch replaces aiter's biased top-k kernel and its two-phase opus
+moe_sorting. The outputs follow aiter.fused_moe.moe_sorting's contract, so
+they can stand in for its return value (see csrc/kimi_k3/route_sort.cuh).

+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit, make_cpp_args
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+MAX_TOKENS: int = 64
+

+    topk_weights: torch.Tensor  # [M, topk] fp32
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor  # [M, topk] int32
+    sorted_ids: torch.Tensor
+    sorted_weights: torch.Tensor
+    sorted_expert_ids: torch.Tensor
+    num_valid_ids: torch.Tensor
+    moe_buf: torch.Tensor
+    # Stage-1 MXFP8 activations as aiter.fused_dynamic_mxfp8_quant_moe_sort

+    a1: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+    a1_scale: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
+

+    ms: torch.Tensor  # [2, >= T, 2] fp32

+        0 < num_tokens <= MAX_TOKENS
+        and router_logits.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and router_logits.stride(1) == 1
+        and router_logits.stride(0) % 2 == 0
+        and router_logits.data_ptr() % 4 == 0
+        and correction_bias.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32)

+        num_tokens * topk * block_m <= num_tokens * topk + num_experts * block_m - topk

+    correction_bias: torch.Tensor,

+    topk: int,
+    block_m: int,
+    model_dim: int,
+    moe_buf: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    routed_scaling_factor: float,

+    device = router_logits.device

+    sorted_weights = torch.empty(max_rows, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    sorted_expert_ids = torch.empty(max_blocks, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    num_valid_ids = torch.empty(2, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    if moe_buf is None:
+        moe_buf = torch.empty(
+            (num_tokens, model_dim), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device
+        )
+    fuse_quant = quant_input is not None
+    if fuse_quant:
+        # Same shapes / dtypes as aiter's fused_dynamic_mx_quant_moe_sort.
+        cols = quant_input.shape[1]
+        a1 = torch.empty((num_tokens, cols), dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device=device)
+        scale_n_pad = ((cols + 31) // 32 + 7) // 8 * 8
+        a1_scale = torch.empty(
+            ((max_rows + 31) // 32 * 32, scale_n_pad),
+            dtype=torch.float8_e8m0fnu,
+            device=device,
+        )
+    else:
+        quant_input = a1 = a1_scale = sorted_ids  # unread placeholders
+    if partials is None:
+        # unread placeholders; no rows launch no partial workgroups
+        partial_args = (sorted_ids,) * 5 + (0, 0, 0, 0.0)
+    else:
+        cw0, cw1 = partials.score_weights
+        partial_args = (
+            partials.bank,
+            cw0,
+            cw0 if cw1 is None else cw1,
+            partials.acc,
+            partials.ms,
+            partials.nvb,
+            1 if cw1 is None else 2,
+            partials.bank.shape[0],
+            float(partials.score_eps),
+        )
+    module = _jit_route_sort_module(
+        num_experts, topk, correction_bias.dtype, fuse_quant, topk_output is not None
+    )
+    module.run(
+        router_logits,
+        correction_bias,
+        topk_weights,
+        topk_ids,
+        sorted_ids,
+        sorted_weights,
+        sorted_expert_ids,
+        num_valid_ids,
+        moe_buf.view(-1),
+        quant_input,
+        a1.view(torch.uint8) if fuse_quant else a1,
+        a1_scale.view(torch.uint8) if fuse_quant else a1_scale,
+        block_m,
+        float(routed_scaling_factor),
+        renormalize,
+        direct,
+        *partial_args,
+    )
+    return RouteSortOutput(
+        topk_weights,
+        topk_ids,
+        sorted_ids,
+        sorted_weights,
+        sorted_expert_ids,
+        num_valid_ids,
+        moe_buf,
+        a1 if fuse_quant else None,
+        a1_scale if fuse_quant else None,
+    )

+        latent = (torch.randn(rows, L, generator=g, device="cuda") * 3).bfloat16()
+        shared = torch.randn(rows, H, generator=g, device="cuda").bfloat16()

+        flips the projection's rounding ahead of a cancelling add)."""
+        for rows in (1, 4, 32):

+        rows_n = H // 8

+

+            w = (torch.randn(E, *shape, generator=g, device="cuda") * scale).bfloat16()

+"""The gfx950 Kimi-K3 fused router top-k + MoE route sort against aiter's chain."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# backend-specific: the route sort hands aiter's gfx950 A8W4 MoE its routes.
+register_amd_ci(est_time=30, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+# Kimi-K3 TP8: 896 experts, top-16, latent 3584, hidden 7168, up to 8 bank rows.
+E, K, LATENT, H, NB = 896, 16, 3584, 7168, 9
+BLOCK_M = 32
+
+
+def _routes(out, num_tokens):
+    """{(token, slot): (row, weight)} over the valid rows; padding rows carry weight 0."""
+    pad = (K << 24) | num_tokens
+    ids, weights = out.sorted_ids.cpu(), out.sorted_weights.cpu()
+    routes = {}
+    for row in range(int(out.num_valid_ids[0])):
+        v = int(ids[row])
+        if v == pad:
+            assert float(weights[row]) == 0.0
+            continue
+        routes[(v & 0xFFFFFF, v >> 24)] = (row, float(weights[row]))
+    return routes
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_gfx95_supported(), "gfx950 route sort")
+class TestKimiK3RouteSort(CustomTestCase):
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_matches_aiter_topk_sort_and_quant(self):
+        """On router logits strided inside the fused front's output, one launch gives
+        aiter's biased top-k and moe_sorting (ids, sorted rows, expert blocks, valid
+        counts), a zeroed moe_buf and fused_dynamic_mxfp8_quant_moe_sort's
+        activations; a NaN or saturated logits row still yields 16 distinct experts."""
+        import aiter
+        from aiter import biased_grouped_topk
+        from aiter.fused_moe import moe_sorting
+
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.kimi_k3_route_sort import route_sort
+
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(2)
+        bias = (torch.randn(E, generator=g, device="cuda") * 0.05).bfloat16()
+        for num_tokens in (1, 4, 16):
+            front = torch.randn(
+                num_tokens, 1536 + E + LATENT, generator=g, device="cuda"
+            )
+            front = (front * 2).bfloat16()
+            logits, routed = front[:, 1536 : 1536 + E], front[:, 1536 + E :]
+            want_w = torch.empty(num_tokens, K, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+            want_ids = torch.empty(num_tokens, K, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+            biased_grouped_topk(logits, bias, want_w, want_ids, 1, 1, True, 1.0)
+            sorted_ids, _, sorted_experts, num_valid, _ = moe_sorting(
+                want_ids, want_w, E, LATENT, torch.bfloat16, BLOCK_M
+            )
+            buf = torch.full((num_tokens, LATENT), 5.0, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+            got = route_sort(
+                logits, bias, topk=K, block_m=BLOCK_M, model_dim=LATENT, moe_buf=buf,
+                routed_scaling_factor=1.0, renormalize=True, quant_input=routed,
+            )  # fmt: skip
+            want_a1, _ = aiter.fused_dynamic_mxfp8_quant_moe_sort(
+                routed, sorted_ids, num_valid, num_tokens, K, BLOCK_M
+            )
+            rows = int(num_valid[0])
+            with self.subTest(num_tokens=num_tokens):
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(got.topk_ids, want_ids))
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    got.topk_weights, want_w, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-7
+                )
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(got.num_valid_ids, num_valid))
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(got.sorted_ids[:rows], sorted_ids[:rows]))
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    torch.equal(
+                        got.sorted_expert_ids[: rows // BLOCK_M],
+                        sorted_experts[: rows // BLOCK_M],
+                    )
+                )
+                self.assertTrue(bool((buf == 0).all()))
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    torch.equal(got.a1.view(torch.uint8), want_a1.view(torch.uint8))
+                )
+            bad = front.clone()
+            bad[0, 1536 : 1536 + E] = float("nan")
+            bad[-1, 1536 : 1536 + E] = -1e30
+            ids = route_sort(
+                bad[:, 1536 : 1536 + E], bias, topk=K, block_m=BLOCK_M,
+                model_dim=LATENT, moe_buf=None, routed_scaling_factor=1.0,
+                renormalize=True,
+            ).topk_ids  # fmt: skip
+            with self.subTest(num_tokens=num_tokens, degenerate=True):
+                self.assertTrue(bool(((ids >= 0) & (ids < E)).all()))
+                self.assertTrue(all(len(set(row)) == K for row in ids.tolist()))
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_route_direct_layout_carries_every_route_once(self):
+        """The route-direct layout gives route t * K + k block t * K + k with the
+        route's expert, token, slot and weight in its first row, and its fused
+        stage-1 activation scales; the routes are those of the expert-grouped layout."""
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.moe import kimi_k3_route_sort as rs
+
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+        bias = torch.randn(E, generator=g, device="cuda") * 0.1
+        for num_tokens in (1, 4, 8):

+            with self.subTest(num_tokens=num_tokens):

+                    direct.num_valid_ids.tolist(),
+                    [num_tokens * K * BLOCK_M, num_tokens],
+                )

+                experts = direct.sorted_expert_ids.cpu()
+                scales_d = direct.a1_scale.view(torch.uint8).cpu()
+                scales_g = grouped.a1_scale.view(torch.uint8).cpu()
+                for (t, k), (row, weight) in got.items():
+                    r = t * K + k
+                    self.assertEqual(row, r * BLOCK_M)

+                    self.assertEqual(weight, want[(t, k)][1])
+                    self.assertTrue(
+                        torch.equal(
+                            _row_scales(scales_d, row),
+                            _row_scales(scales_g, want[(t, k)][0]),
+                        )
+                    )
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_bank_partials(self):
+        """The spare workgroups' partials are the bank's softmax partial sums the
+        fused reads merge: per row and score vector, m = max score, sum =
+        sum exp(score - m), acc = sum exp(score - m) * bank row, score =
+        <bank row, cw> / rms(bank row); a second vector only when given."""
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.moe import kimi_k3_route_sort as rs
+
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1)
+        bias = torch.randn(E, generator=g, device="cuda") * 0.1
+        acc = torch.zeros(2, 64, H, device="cuda")
+        ms = torch.zeros(2, 64, 2, device="cuda")
+        eps = 1e-6
+        for num_tokens, nvb, sides in ((1, 2, 2), (4, 8, 2), (16, 5, 1)):
+            logits = torch.randn(num_tokens, E, generator=g, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+            bank = (
+                torch.randn(num_tokens, NB, H, generator=g, device="cuda") * 3
+            ).bfloat16()
+            cws = [
+                torch.randn(H, generator=g, device="cuda") * 0.05 for _ in range(sides)
+            ]
+            acc.zero_()
+            ms.zero_()
+            rs.route_sort(
+                logits,
+                bias,
+                topk=K,
+                block_m=BLOCK_M,
+                model_dim=LATENT,
+                moe_buf=None,
+                routed_scaling_factor=1.0,
+                renormalize=True,
+                partials=rs.BankPartials(
+                    bank=bank,
+                    nvb=nvb,
+                    score_weights=(cws[0], cws[1] if sides == 2 else None),
+                    score_eps=eps,
+                    acc=acc,
+                    ms=ms,
+                ),
+            )
+            b = bank[:, :nvb].float()
+            rms = torch.sqrt((b * b).mean(-1) + eps)
+            with self.subTest(num_tokens=num_tokens, nvb=nvb, sides=sides):
+                for side, cw in enumerate(cws):
+                    score = (b * cw).sum(-1) / rms
+                    m = score.max(-1).values
+                    e = torch.exp(score - m[:, None])
+                    want = (e[:, :, None] * b).sum(1)
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        acc[side, :num_tokens], want, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-3
+                    )
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(
+                        ms[side, :num_tokens],
+                        torch.stack([m, e.sum(-1)], -1),
+                        rtol=1e-4,
+                        atol=1e-4,
+                    )
+                if sides == 1:
+                    self.assertEqual(acc[1].abs().max().item(), 0.0)
+
+
+def _row_scales(scales: torch.Tensor, row: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The e8m0 group scales of a sorted row in aiter's shuffled layout."""
+    n_pad = scales.shape[1]
+    flat = scales.flatten()
+    idx = [
+        (row // 32 * n_pad) * 32
+        + (g // 8) * 256
+        + (g % 4) * 64
+        + (row % 16) * 4
+        + (g % 8) // 4 * 2
+        + (row % 32) // 16
+        for g in range(LATENT // 32)
+    ]
+    return flat[idx]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
